node.title: Re: chunking up texts correctly for online translation
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Q1: How do I rewrite my script so that I get paragraph-sized chunks getting sent to google regardless of line feed encoding?

You're right that paragraph mode ($/ = "") doesn't work right when reading a CRLF file on *NIX. You could enable the :crlf [doc://PerlIO] layer, which will leave plain LF as is but convert CRLF to LF, and paragraph mode will work: open my $fh, '<:crlf', $file

By the way, to pick two nits: Module names in all lowercase are reserved (by convention) for pragmas, so I'd name your module Translate. Also, you're not checking your [doc://open] for errors.

Q2: Do I really need all of this to extract one paragraph of translation?

In general I'd say get it fully working first, and leave the simplification of the code for a little later :-)
